## Summary

- Nandi Proteins Limited (SC213462) is an active private limited company incorporated on 4 December 2000, trading under SIC codes 10890 and 82990, with roughly 25 years of trading history. `[profile; computed]`
- The board currently has 3 active officers, with 26 officers recorded over the company's life and no new appointments in the last 12 months. `[officers]`
- Only one charge has ever been registered — a floating charge created on 30 January 2009 in favour of Svenska Handelsbanken Ab (Publ) — and it is recorded as fully satisfied, so the company has a clean security position and a first-charge facility could be offered subject to the remaining policies. `[created 2009-01-30 · Svenska Handelsbanken Ab (P…; SEC-02; SEC-03]`
- Filing conduct is mixed: the most recent accounts (to 31 December 2025) were filed on 21 July 2026, 69 days ahead of deadline, but the prior year's accounts to 31 December 2024 were filed on 12 March 2026, 165 days late. `[AA filed 2026-07-21; AA filed 2026-03-12]`
- That 165-day delay triggers CON-01 as a referral point, since accounts filed more than 30 days after the statutory deadline indicate weak administrative control — worth asking the directors to explain the 2024 year-end delay. `[CON-01; AA filed 2026-03-12]`
- The latest accounts were filed on the total exemption full basis, which triggers CON-04: these do not disclose turnover or profit, so management accounts covering the most recent 12 months must be obtained before any decision. `[CON-04; profile; AA filed 2026-07-21]`
- Accounts are not overdue and the next set is not due until 30 September 2027, so there is no immediate filing deficiency to resolve — the referral rests on filing history and accounts detail rather than security. `[profile; CON-01; CON-04]`
